name: attention_vjeux_tile128_b32_v1
hypothesis: Specialize only full-context q_len=8 batch 32 to a 128-key pipeline tile; preserve the public-scored 64-key implementation for every other shape. Target the measured 188 us full-verify-32 bottleneck.
decision_reason: The tile-128 specialization compiles but fails the official reference check on full verify-32 (relative L2 0.331 vs bound 0.084); no timing or official check was attempted. Keep the public-scored tile-64 path.
